description: 评估验证系统 - 对智能阅读概念图谱系统进行端到端、API契约、UI自动化验证

userStories.title: 创建评估脚本框架和健康检查
userStories.description: As an evaluation system, I need to create the evaluation script framework with service startup and health check.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/run-evaluation.sh as main evaluation entry point
Script can start backend (cargo run) and frontend (npm run dev)
Script polls GET /api/health until service is ready (max 60s)
Script reports clear error if service fails to start
Script handles Ctrl+C gracefully (cleanup processes)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 实现测试数据准备 - 上传样本书籍
userStories.description: As an evaluation system, I need to upload sample books via API to prepare test data.
acceptanceCriteria: Find PDF and EPUB files in sample_books/ directory
Upload each sample book via POST /api/books/upload with multipart/form-data
Record returned book_id for each uploaded book
Verify uploaded books appear in GET /api/books list
Report upload failures with clear error messages
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 实现端到端功能测试 - 全流程验证
userStories.description: As an evaluation system, I need to verify the complete flow from upload to graph generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse uploaded book: POST /api/books/{id}/parse returns chunks_created > 0
Extract concepts: POST /api/books/{id}/extract returns nodes_count > 0
Get graph: GET /api/books/{id}/graph returns non-empty nodes and edges arrays
All steps return HTTP 200 with no error fields
Failed step records error and terminates flow
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 实现 API 契约测试套件
userStories.description: As an evaluation system, I need to test all REST API endpoints for correct behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/health returns {status: 'ok'}
GET /api/settings/language returns {language: 'zh'|'en'}
PUT /api/settings/language accepts {language: 'zh'|'en'} and updates setting
GET /api/books returns array of books
GET /api/books/{id} returns book details
GET /api/books/{id}/chunks returns array of chunks
GET /api/books/{id}/graph returns {nodes: [], edges: []}
DELETE /api/books/{id} returns {deleted: true}
Error cases return appropriate HTTP status codes (400, 404, 500)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 生成评估报告
userStories.description: As an evaluation system, I need to generate structured evaluation reports after each run.
acceptanceCriteria: Report saved to tasks/evaluation-report-YYYY-MM-DD.md
Report includes: execution time, test scope, pass/fail statistics
Report includes detailed results for each test case
Report includes discovered issues grouped by severity (BLOCKING/HIGH/MEDIUM/SUGGESTION)
Report includes issue description, location, severity, suggested fix
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 建立问题跟踪机制
userStories.description: As an evaluation system, I need to track discovered issues and verify fixes in subsequent runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Each evaluation report includes 'Open Issues' list
Issues tracked with: description, location, severity, suggested fix, status
Issue status transitions: New -> In Progress -> Resolved
Re-evaluation after fix should mark issue as Resolved
Generate summary of issue resolution rate
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: UI 浏览器自动化验证
userStories.description: As an evaluation system, I need to verify UI components render and function correctly using browser automation.
acceptanceCriteria: Use dev-browser skill to launch browser and navigate to http://localhost:3000
Verify homepage loads and displays book list
Verify PDF reader component renders when book is selected
Verify EPUB reader component renders when book is selected
Verify graph visualization component renders nodes and edges
Capture and log console errors (Error level only)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: 编译和类型检查验证
userStories.description: As an evaluation system, I need to verify the project compiles and passes type checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend: cargo check passes without errors or warnings
Frontend: npm run typecheck passes without errors
Frontend: npm run build generates dist/ without errors
Report compilation warnings as issues
Typecheck passes
